name: io.github.k-luecke/paxiom-receipts
title: Paxiom Receipts MCP
description: Verify, issue, and explain Ed25519 delivery receipts (paxiom.receipt.v0) for x402 APIs.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Validate an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt (JSON Schema, Ed25519 signature, signer authorization via expectedIssuerPublicKeys / expectedPayTo, JCS or raw SHA-256 output binding, expiry, and settlement trust state) and return structured JSON fields. Use this instead of explain_receipt when automated code branches on valid or trustState; use explain_receipt when presenting human-readable guidance, or get_x402_verifier_info for live on-chain settlement endpoints. Deterministic, offline, and free with no auth: invalid or tampered receipts return isError=false with valid=false and the failing trustState, omitting output caps trustState at valid_signature_only, and omitting trustedVerifierPublicKeys trusts the host counter-attestation key by default.

receipt.description: Parsed paxiom.receipt.v0 JSON envelope (decoded from Payment-Receipt or X-Paxiom-Receipt HTTP header).

output.description: Optional delivered HTTP response payload (JSON value for jcs-sha256, or UTF-8 string for raw-sha256); required to reach trustState="verified".

expectedIssuerPublicKeys.description: Optional pinned base64 Ed25519 seller public keys (e.g. from /.well-known/x402-keys.json). Mismatch returns trustState="unauthorized_issuer".

expectedPayTo.description: Optional expected seller payTo address from the 402 quote. Mismatch returns trustState="unauthorized_issuer".

trustedVerifierPublicKeys.description: Optional canonical base64 32-byte Ed25519 public keys trusted to assert settlement.checkedByVerifier=true (defaults to the host key).

tools.name: explain_receipt
tools.description: Format a plain-text trust breakdown and next-action remediation checklist for an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt. Use this instead of verify_receipt when displaying a readable verdict to a user or operator; use verify_receipt when code needs raw check fields for programmatic gating, or get_x402_verifier_info to discover live Base USDC settlement endpoints. Runs deterministically offline for free with no auth: tampered, unauthorized, expired, or unconfirmed receipts return isError=false with an actionable diagnostic explanation rather than throwing, and omitting trustedVerifierPublicKeys trusts the host counter-attestation key by default. Pass output with the delivered HTTP response body to check SHA-256 payload binding (omitting output caps trustState at valid_signature_only).

receipt.description: Parsed paxiom.receipt.v0 JSON envelope (decoded from Payment-Receipt or X-Paxiom-Receipt HTTP header).

output.description: Optional delivered HTTP response payload; pass whenever available so SHA-256 payload binding is evaluated alongside the Ed25519 signature.

expectedIssuerPublicKeys.description: Optional pinned base64 Ed25519 seller public keys (e.g. from /.well-known/x402-keys.json).

expectedPayTo.description: Optional expected seller payTo address from the 402 quote.

trustedVerifierPublicKeys.description: Optional canonical base64 32-byte Ed25519 public keys trusted to assert settlement.checkedByVerifier=true (defaults to the host key).

tools.name: get_x402_verifier_info
tools.description: Retrieve Paxiom Receipt Verifier reference service discovery metadata, published Ed25519 counter-attestation public keys (/.well-known/x402-keys.json), and free rate-limited public HTTP endpoints for offline verification, live Base USDC settlement verification (/v1/receipt/verify-live), and pre-payment seller safety preflight (/v1/x402/preflight). Stateless, read-only, and free with no authentication required.
